Lemma
[Evolution inequality for curvature derivatives] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0248 1. ch13:13.28\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

There is $C_n<\infty $ such that \[ \partial _t| abla ^k\Rm |^2\leq \Delta | abla ^k\Rm |^2 -2| abla ^{k+1}\Rm |^2 \] \[ {}+C_n\sum _{i=0}^k rac{(k+2)!}{(i+2)!(k-i)!} | abla ^i\Rm |\, | abla ^{k-i}\Rm |\, | abla ^k\Rm |. \]
Proof

\sketch ↗ cor:chow-ii-nabla-heat-commutator Apply the commutator estimate to $(\partial _t-\Delta )\Rm =(4n+5)\Rm *\Rm $, expand by Leibniz’ rule, and absorb coefficients into $C_n$. Pair with $2 abla ^k\Rm $; the Bochner identity gives the negative gradient term, and variation of the tensor norm is absorbed into the $i=0$ summand.
